_readme: The course's order, in three groups. Each name is a module page, content/pages/modules/<name>.md. A module's number, its file name (module-NN.html, or its front matter's out), the sidebar and the pager all follow this list, so moving a line renumbers the course. Pages link to each other by name ((module:demo-videos), {n:demo-videos}), so links survive a reorder.
